findings.title: Embed template has invalid ERB and will not render
findings.body: The header branch is closed with `<%- end if %>`, which is not valid Ruby/ERB (`end` cannot be followed by `if` like that). When a topic embed exists, EmbedController#best renders this template and ActionView will raise a syntax error, so the comments iframe never shows highlights. It should be `<% end %>`.

findings.title: Imported HTML is stored and shown unsanitized (stored XSS)
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import appends the source URL into an HTML fragment with no escaping (`<a href='#{url}'>`), and the only check is that the string starts with http:// or https://. A URL such as `http://example.com/'><script>...` therefore becomes script in the post body. The same method stores RSS and Readability HTML as cook_method raw_html. Post#cook (app/models/post.rb:133) returns that raw string unchanged, skipping the normal renderer and sanitizer, and the embed view prints it with `raw`. PollFeed also passes feed item HTML straight through (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35). Anyone who can influence the feed, the remote page, or the embed URL can store script that runs for every forum user and inside the embed iframe.

findings.title: import_remote fetches arbitrary URLs with Kernel.open
findings.body: import_remote calls `open(url).read` before any http(s) or host check. Ruby's Kernel.open treats a leading `|` as a shell command, and open-uri will follow redirects to internal addresses and file URLs. Disqus import passes `t[:link]` from the XML export straight into this method, and TopicRetriever only checks the initial host, not the redirect target. An untrusted Disqus file or an embeddable page that redirects can make the worker read local files, hit internal services, or run commands.

findings.title: postMessage targetOrigin is a full referer, not an origin
findings.body: The embed layout calls `parent.postMessage(..., request.referer)`. postMessage's targetOrigin must be an origin (scheme, host, and optional port). A referer includes path and query, so browsers throw or drop the message. The parent frame in embed.js never receives `discourse-resize`, and the iframe height stays at the default.

findings.title: Resize messages are accepted if origin is a substring of discourseUrl
findings.body: The listener keeps a message when `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) !== -1`. That is the reverse of an origin check and is not an equality comparison. Any event whose origin string appears inside the configured discourse URL is trusted, and `e.data.height` is written onto the iframe. A crafted postMessage from a matching substring origin can resize or distort the embed; a trailing-slash or path mismatch can also reject the real forum origin.

findings.title: Feed poll crashes when an item has no content
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` assumes every RSS/Atom item has a content string. Many feeds only set description or summary, so content is nil and this raises NoMethodError. Because the exception is inside `rss.items.each` and the job sets `retry: false`, one incomplete item aborts the whole hourly import and no later items are imported.

findings.title: Content hash is updated even when the revision fails
findings.body: On a changed embed, import always calls `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` after `revise!`, without checking that revise! returned true or that the post saved. If validation, a missing post, or a rollback causes the update to fail, the stored hash still matches the new body, so later polls treat the topic as up to date and never retry the revision.

findings.title: Blank embed username crashes remote fetch
findings.body: fetch_http does `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` with no presence check. PollFeed guards on embed_by_username, but EmbedController enqueues RetrieveTopic for any missing embed, and perform_retrieve calls fetch_http whenever the host is allowed. If the username setting is blank, the job raises NoMethodError on nil and the embed stays on the loading page.

findings.title: Any client with a spoofable referer can enqueue fetch jobs
findings.body: best enqueues :retrieve_topic for every embed_url that is not already imported, with no host check, rate limit, or authentication in the request. The 60-second throttle lives inside the job after it has already been queued. A caller that sets Referer to the embeddable host can flood Sidekiq with retrieve jobs (and each miss may also run a full feed poll). The controller spec expects a synchronous TopicRetriever#retrieve, so this path is also untested and the new spec will fail.

findings.title: embed_url is limited to 255 characters
findings.body: embed_url is a string column, which on this Rails/Postgres setup defaults to varchar(255), with a unique index on the full value. Article and feed URLs with long paths or query strings exceed that limit, so TopicEmbed.create! raises and the import is rolled back. Those pages can never be embedded or polled.
